alternatives.label: F_MED_Ramirez_Fallback
alternatives.notes: Complete fallback female body/head according to previous reference report; no verified texture association. Missing weapon/IK sockets require hand_r fallback; proportions have not been visually retarget-validated.

attachment.notes: weapon_r and ik_hand_gun have zero body vertex influences. A zero weapon_r scale in Dive hides attached weapons; do not invert its singular normal matrix.

recommendations.rifleMovement: Use full-body NoWep locomotion for legs and AR_NonTargeted_Pose_CMM or AR_Targeted_Pose_CMM as an upper-body pose, or explicitly resolve the recovered rifle additive tracks against a suitable reference. Reference pose paths are absent from the cooked additive metadata.
recommendations.rootMotion: Remove the whole root translation when Fightnight simulation controls displacement and jump height. Preserve pelvis/local motion. Most selected root starts are [0,0,0]; inspect rootStart per record (Death_Fwd begins 0.4828cm along UE Y).
recommendations.floorOffset: Native standing feet are near y=0; do not recenter each pose AABB. Dive and HangGlider_Glide intentionally have elevated body bounds, and crouch lowers the head.
recommendations.timing: Use each decoded fps and duration: PickAxe_Swing1 is 97 frames at 121.25fps with 0.8s duration; two-frame pose assets are static poses, not useful time-varying idle loops.

notes: TRS magnitudes and coverage are structural checks, not final visual validation.
Coverage is case-insensitive (Unreal FName); the original reader previously missed Root and Spine_01/02/03.
Additive flags must be interpreted with converter provenance; do not add reference transforms twice. A Core suffix is not proof of an absolute clip; landCore remains additive.
Forward is +Z in this GLTF, from foot->ball vectors and forward clip root motion; Fightnight -Z requires yaw+PI.
Slot mapping is an integration suggestion based on exact recovered names and source paths.
